prose: The mayor of Beartaria Ozarks, Mr Permie Bear (Adam Stevens) joins Vibe Rant alongside Beartarian Major-DOMO Topher Gardner and our court alchemist, Kyle Denton of Tippecanoe Herbs. Adam's permaculture philosophy towards life allows him to turn problems into opportunities, and leading by example, he's been essential to the success of the annual Beartaria festival. Tonight we'll capture some of that inspiration and have some laughs.
music: Vibe Rant intro theme by VOLO
